We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 3 reactions, using templates 1914393, 1914394, 1914395 in this order. We have applied 1914393 to target, got two fragments: 'COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1' and 'FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1'. Actually result tuple: (('COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1', 'FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1'),). So first reaction splits target into two precursors.

Now we need to apply template 1914394 to one of those fragments (presumably the second fragment). We applied 1914394 to 'FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1' and got ('ClCCl', 'FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1'). So second reaction splits that fragment into 'ClCCl' (dichloromethane?) and 'FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1'.

Now we need third reaction using template 1914395 applied to one of the remaining fragments, likely 'FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1' or maybe the first fragment 'COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1' also needs further disconnection. The requirement: route must have at least 3 reactions, using templates in this order. So we need three reaction nodes: first using 1914393, second using 1914394, third using 1914395. The final leaves should be simple buyable molecules (maybe). We need to get precursors for the third step.

We need to get template 1914395 details.
